subject: Resolve friend-swap targets through Original AI Position semantics
description: `parity-random-save-replays/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_069/replay-001-session-0001.jsonl.zst` historically first diverged after frame 444 because Soldier197 entered swordfight against PC244 in Rust while Original retained PC247; the resulting genuine `RHElementActorHuman::EnterSwordFight` visibility query had PC244's upright-eye destination instead of PC247's. Original `RHArtificialMalignity::ReconsiderEnemyApproach` resolves both `Position(pFriend)` and `Position(pFriend->GetPrimaryTarget())` before its strict target-exchange comparison (`original-code/RHartificialmalignity.cpp:6569-6648`), and `RHArtificialIntelligence::Position` returns the committed gate endpoint while an actor is passing a door (`original-code/RHartificialintelligence.cpp:4307-4348`). At frame 443, PC244 and PC247 are both passing door 53 directly, so Original resolves both targets to the same point-in and the strict target-exchange inequality cannot pass. Rust's friend-swap candidate builder instead used PC244's interpolated actor position, making the exchange appear shorter and swapping Soldier197's PC247 with Soldier198's PC244. Finalized commit `00e15d031` resolves both the friend and its primary target through the shared source-faithful AI-position helper before evaluating the exchange; it builds on the common door-first/carried-PC resolver integrated by `21d20b27a338d7e813f720ee6210465bcc0a94cb`. The focused `friend_swap_candidates_resolve_both_friend_and_target_through_ai_position` regression passes. This boundary is distinct from Task319's replay-011 frame-184 PassDoor route-source boundary and is simulation-owned rather than presentation visibility. The optimized parity-profile runner builds successfully, and the representative now matches exact EOF through all 750 recorded simulation-frame records: the first advances frame 20 to 21 and the terminator follows final frame 770.
